entities.name: Ahmet Düverioğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ahmet Düverioğlu, known as Ahmad Hekmat Al-Dwairi in Jordan, is a Turkish-Jordanian international professional basketball player for Esenler Erokspor of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL). He uses his Turkish passport in the EuroLeague competition. Standing at a height of 2.13 m, he plays at the center position.
